**Automated Driving, Electric & Connected Mobility, IoT or Connectivity,**
our ideas make driving safer and more comfortable than ever before. This is only possible with the help of more than
**1000 talented engineers**
from Bosch Engineering Center Cluj specialized in software, hardware & mechanics and reliability engineering, who work closely together with other Engineering Centers within Bosch and with Bosch Cluj Plant in order to offer
**unique products**
and
**AIoT**
solutions to our clients from around the world.

So, are you ready to

together with us? Let us tell you more. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: we
**grow**

**enjoy**

**inspire**
each other. Join in and feel the difference.

**Job Description**

**Bosch Engineering Center Cluj**
is offering scholarships of 2000 RON/month over the academic year for enthusiastic candidates with outstanding academic results. Students granted with scholarships must elaborate their master thesis in partnership with mentors from Robert Bosch, on one of the following subjects:

* AI embedded / edge AI;
* AI chips design;
* Neural networks optimizations;
* HW friendly AI architecture;
* Knowledge distillation from large to small embedded models;
* Real-time physical AI;
* AI training HW and training optimization techniques (stretched objective);
* Hardware-Software co-design.

**Qualifications**

* Students from 2nd year of study;
* Previous year’s average grade: minimum 7;
* You have outstanding results;
* You get involved in projects and participate at challenges;
* You like to work in teams;
* You like to take initiative and you are ambitious, proactive and have a self-driven working style.

**Eligible specializations**
:

* **Technical University of Cluj-Napoca:**
  Faculty of Automation and Computer Science, Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Faculty of Electronics, Telecommunications and Information Technology, Faculty of Automotive, Mechatronics and Mechanical Engineering,
* **Babeș – Bolyai University**
  : Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science

**Application process:**

* Submit your CV
  until the
  **18th of October**
* Technical interview period between
  **23rd of October - 3rd of November.**

For more information contact us on
**ECCAcademicPrograms@ro.bosch.com**

**Additional Information**

**Benefits of being in the Bosch Scholarship Program:**

* Scholarship of
  **2000 RON/month;**
* Soft skills and technical skills trainings/workshops;
* Access to educational resources within Bosch;
* Practical professional experience
* Get involved in Projects & Network with our community of professionals
* Networking possibility with IT experts;
* Possibility to use our Engineering Hub for university/personal projects.
